title: PromiseObject
description: Fulfilment and delivery promise candidate evaluated with deterministic calculators and evidence chains.

candidate_id.description: Identifier of the parallel promise candidate (e.g. candidate_0, candidate_1)

fulfilment_node_id.description: Store or DC node code fulfilling the order

atp_units.description: Available-to-promise units computed by deterministic calculator

carrier_cutoff.description: Last time carrier accepts packages for targeted delivery window

transit_hours.description: Transit time in hours calculated via Google Maps isochrones/matrix

margin_pct.description: Net margin percentage after landed and fulfilment costs

isochrone_feasible.description: True if delivery location is within feasible travel-time isochrone

computation_id.description: Audit hash of deterministic calculator inputs and outputs

evidence_chain.description: Traceable references to inventory snapshot, maps route id, and cutoff schedule
